threads.name: The Rockefeller Legacy at The Met
threads.description: This theme connects the stops through the influence of the Rockefeller family, particularly Nelson A. Rockefeller and his son Michael Rockefeller, who played a significant role in the development of The Met's collections and wings.

threads.name: The Evolution of The Met's Collections
threads.description: This theme traces the growth and changes in The Met's collections over time, highlighting key dates and expansions that shaped its current form.

threads.name: Cultural Exchange and Influence
threads.description: This theme explores how The Met's exhibitions reflect a blend of cultural influences, particularly through the arts of Africa, Oceania, and the Americas.
